sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups exhibiting all-green performance, led by sustained, dominant momentum in Technology (0.950).

Market leadership is concentrated at the top, where Technology and Healthcare continue to outpace the broader market. Technology holds sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, while Energy maintains the top YTD rank (rank 1) with robust momentum (0.667). 

Short-term rotations were muted over the past five sessions, marked only by Consumer Defensive edging up one spot to rank 6 and Financial slipping one spot to rank 7. Fading interest remains anchored in defensive bond-proxies and cyclicals, with Utilities (0.033), Real Estate (0.233), and Consumer Cyclical (0.250) trapped at the bottom of the momentum spectrum.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors maintain all-green status across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD timeframes: Technology (momentum 0.950) and Communication Services (momentum 0.650).
- **Persistent Outperformer:** Technology is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength, remaining in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank metrics.
- **Top Absolute Momentum:** Technology (0.950, rank 2 YTD) and Healthcare (0.733, rank 5 YTD) lead all sectors in momentum score.

## Movers & Momentum
- **5-Day Improver:** Consumer Defensive was the sole positive mover, advancing +1 spot to reach rank 6 with a momentum score of 0.417.
- **5-Day Decliner:** Financial was the sole sector to lose ground, falling -1 spot to rank 7 with a momentum score of 0.483.
- **Bottom Tier Drag:** Utilities anchors the momentum basement at 0.033 (rank 10 YTD), followed closely by Real Estate at 0.233 (rank 8 YTD) and Consumer Cyclical at 0.250 (rank 11 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Communication Services Rank vs. Breadth:** Communication Services holds all-green status with a solid 0.650 momentum score, yet sits low at rank 9 for YTD performance.
- **Energy YTD Rank vs. Momentum:** Energy holds the #1 rank YTD, but sits in third place for momentum (0.667), trailing both Technology (0.950) and Healthcare (0.733).

* Relative strength is fading sharply in Communication Services and Energy, where an apparent 0.50 rs_score (3/7 timeframes) drops to an rs_confirmed of just 0.17 due to weak directional consistency.
* Laggard sectors show severe relative weakness rather than stabilization, with Healthcare beating SPY on only 1/7 timeframes (rs_score 0.17, rs_confirmed 0.17) and Consumer Cyclical failing completely at 0/7 timeframes (rs_score 0.00, rs_confirmed 0.00).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** High-momentum technology and healthcare groups continue to anchor overall market strength, while cyclicals and beaten-down consumer segments show sharp short-term rank rebounds.

Market breadth remains narrow with only 8 of 144 industry groups positive across all timeframes. Dominance is concentrated in core tech hardware, chips, and specialized healthcare: Semiconductors (0.94 momentum), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.94), and Computer Hardware (0.94) hold top-tier momentum and sustained multi-month leadership. Conversely, Solar (0.059) and Gambling (0.069) sit anchored at the bottom of the rankings.

Short-term rotation is surfacing in lower-momentum pockets. Real Estate - Diversified surged 21 spots over the past 5 sessions, while Airlines and Pharmaceutical Retailers each gained 19 spots. Meanwhile, distribution and ag-related industries are rapidly losing standing, led by Integrated Freight & Logistics (-18 spots) and Paper & Paper Products (-17 spots).

## Strength
* **Broad-based winners:** 8 of 144 groups are all-green across all time horizons, led by Semiconductors (momentum 0.94), Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.94), Computer Hardware (momentum 0.94), and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.91).
* **Sustained leadership:** Groups holding top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include Computer Hardware (YTD rank 1), Electronics & Computer Distribution (YTD rank 3), Semiconductors (YTD rank 7), Consumer Electronics, Diagnostics & Research, Health Information Services, Internet Content & Information, and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.
* **Momentum extremes:** The weakest groups in the market remain deeply depressed, with Solar (momentum 0.059, YTD rank 138), Gambling (momentum 0.069, YTD rank 143), and Personal Services (momentum 0.085, YTD rank 137) showing no signs of recovery.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top 5-day advancers:** Real Estate - Diversified gained +21 spots to reach rank 84 (momentum 0.66), Airlines rose +19 spots to rank 85 (momentum 0.63), and Pharmaceutical Retailers jumped +19 spots to rank 105 (momentum 0.64).
* **High-momentum movers:** Diagnostics & Research advanced +13 spots to rank 32 while sustaining an elite 0.91 momentum score.
* **Top 5-day decliners:** Integrated Freight & Logistics dropped -18 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.35), Paper & Paper Products fell -17 spots to rank 112 (momentum 0.40), and Agricultural Inputs slipped -13 spots to rank 38 (momentum 0.47).

## Divergences
* **Fading momentum leaders:** Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.73) dropped 4 rank spots in 5 days, while Silver (momentum 0.68, -2 spots), Insurance - Life (momentum 0.67, -3 spots), and Oil & Gas Equipment & Services (momentum 0.65, -2 spots) are showing short-term slippage despite elevated momentum.
* **Emerging low-momentum rebounds:** Residential Construction gained +11 rank spots over 5 days despite weak 0.39 momentum; similarly, Apparel Retail gained +10 spots (momentum 0.44) and Coking Coal climbed +6 spots (momentum 0.42).
